title: AWS Step Functions to Amazon EventBridge
description: Creates a Step Functions workflow that publishes events to EventBridge

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The AWS SAM template deploys a Step Functions workflow that publishes an event to an EventBridge event bus. An IAM Role allows the workflow execution to publish events onto the event bus. An EventBridge rule forwards all events to a CloudWatch Logs log group for easy inspection.
